Good questions

Here are a few answers.

Join the next cohort →
When do I start getting paid gigs?

We’re building two pathways to help you access paid work. First, we’re bringing founders into the community to share opportunities and connect members to relevant projects. Second, we have a paid funnel that brings projects directly into the community for participants to share and access.

As you learn, sharpen your skills and build your portfolio throughout the eight weeks, you’ll be better positioned to take on these opportunities.

What does supervision and accountability mean?

Hilda and other members of the community are here to give you 100% support on your personal and general marketing projects or problems. Whether you’re stuck on a task, need feedback on your work, or are trying to figure out a marketing challenge, you have people you can turn to for guidance and support.

Can I do this alongside work, school or other commitments?

Yes, as long as you can consistently make time for the live sessions, assignments, feedback and portfolio work.

What if I can’t pay the full fee right now?

You can split the ₦30,000 fee into two instalments. Agree on a date for the remaining half. Your seat is confirmed after the required payment is verified.

Is this programme only for people who want to freelance?

No. The skills can support your path into a full-time role, consulting, freelancing or building your own business.

What if I already have marketing experience?

The programme is designed to help you apply what you know, strengthen your work, build a portfolio and prepare for your next professional opportunity.
